code-input.name: Code Input
code-input.purpose: Capture one bounded verification code as one accessible grouped field with paste, completion, timer, and recovery states.

anatomy.rule: Represent each digit while preserving one logical input.
Shows timer, resend, or recovery guidance.
Makes the active slot visible without splitting semantics.
Confirms entry without submitting unrelated flows.

variants.description: SMS-delivered verification code with timer or resend helper copy.
Generic one-time password or authenticator-app code.

code-input.statePrecedence: disabled > error > warning > complete > focus > hover > default

Energy.decision: Use semantic focus, success, warning, and error color.

Voice.decision: Use direct security and recovery copy.
Voice.behavior: Users know what code is needed.

Frame.decision: Reuse Input label, helper, and density rhythm while OTP owns grouped slot geometry.

Depth.decision: Use a light field surface only.
Depth.behavior: OTP does not become a card system.

Momentum.decision: Use Design System focus and error motion with reduced motion.

State.decision: Disabled and error resolve before completion.

Tone.decision: Use warning for expiring or resend states.

Growth.decision: Escalate login and biometric orchestration to patterns.

Symbol.decision: Use symbols only in helper or recovery actions.

Iconography.decision: Use Design System icon sizing for recovery actions.

Accessibility.decision: Expose one logical input and paste/autocomplete behavior.
Accessibility.behavior: Screen readers do not traverse fake fields.

props.name: length
props.notes: Number of code digits; use this instead of creating digit-count variants.

props.name: variant
props.notes: Semantic treatment for code source or sensitivity while preserving one logical input.

props.name: masked
props.notes: Masks visible slot digits while keeping the underlying one-time-code input value.

props.name: density
props.notes: Maps to the shared Input rhythm for label, helper, and slot size.

props.name: error
props.notes: Error helper text; sets aria-invalid on code slots.

props.name: onComplete
props.notes: Called when all digits are filled.

do: Keep timer and resend copy visible.
dont: Do not own the full login system.
Do not split screen reader focus across fake fields.
Do not hide expired state in color.

agentInstructions: Use Code Input for one verification code.
Treat SMS and OTP as variants of Code Input, not separate components.
Do not use Code Input to implement PasscodeKeypad; authentication patterns own keypad, dots, biometric, and backspace behavior.
Ask before designing the auth sequence.
Keep resend and expiry copy explicit.

notCovered.label: PasscodeKeypad
notCovered.decision: Authentication pattern; do not fold keypad, dots, biometric, or backspace behavior into Code Input.
